input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: The only indemnity in the Agreement runs one way: Article XII (p0128-p0129) requires Licensee to defend and indemnify Licensor for the exercise of its own licence rights, its business conduct and any breach, and there is no Licensor indemnity anywhere in the document (searches for "indemn", "harmless" and "defend" return no Licensor-side obligation). Article XIII compounds this by expressly providing that "UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE ... THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED ... IN ANY INFRINGEMENT ... OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ... RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON", and caps all Licensor liability at one half of amounts paid. That is walk-away territory (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity), so it fails the fallback. We propose the fallback package only: a Licensor IP indemnity with the customary Licensee modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap, plus two surgical "subject to Article XIII-A" conforming edits so the retained Article XIII infringement exclusion and 0.5x cap do not contradict the new indemnity. We have not sought the preferred additions (defence duty, affiliates, breach-of-law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct prongs, claim procedure, narrowed Licensee indemnity) at this level.

proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap, and conform the liability limits.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII gives Licensor a broad one-way indemnity while Article XIII expressly bars any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we have no protection if the Licensed Technology infringes a third party's IP. We have added a fallback-level Licensor IP indemnity (with the usual Licensee modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap) and made the Article XIII limitations subject to it.

ops.text: ARTICLE XIII-A LICENSOR INDEMNITY Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against any third-party claim alleging that the Licensed Technology infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from (i) modifications to the Licensed Technology made by Licensee, (ii) combination of the Licensed Technology with items not supplied by Licensor, or (iii) Licensee's specifications. Licensor shall, at its option, procure the right for Licensee to continue using, modify, or replace the affected Licensed Technology, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, shall refund the fees paid for the affected Licensed Technology. Licensor's total liability for its indemnification obligations under this Article XIII-A shall not exceed three (3) times the fees paid by Licensee to Licensor under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
